description: This file contains unit tests for the RetrieveConnectionLogsAggregatorActor class, testing its behavior with various responses, timeouts, and log size constraints in the context of retrieving connection logs within a messaging connectivity service.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionLogsAggregatorActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for Verify behavior of RetrieveConnectionLogsAggregatorActor, including multiple scenarios like normal responses, size limits, and timeouts.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem before tests run.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests complete.

methods.name: withOneClient
methods.description: Tests the response when there is a single client connection.

methods.name: withMultipleClients
methods.description: Tests aggregation of multiple client log responses.

methods.name: withMultipleClientsRespectsMaxLogSize
methods.description: Ensures the total log size does not exceed maximum allowed size.

methods.name: maxSizeLogEntries
methods.description: Generates log entries repeatedly until the maximum log size is reached for testing.

methods.name: correlationId
methods.description: Generates a random UUID for correlation purposes.

methods.name: withTimeoutAndWithoutMessages
methods.description: Verifies timeout behavior when no log responses are received.

methods.name: withTimeoutWithMessages
methods.description: Tests timeout handling when only part of the responses are received.

methods.name: createRetrieveConnectionLogsResponse
methods.description: Helper to create mock RetrieveConnectionLogsResponse objects with specified parameters.

methods.name: createExpectedResponse
methods.description: Merges multiple client responses into one expected aggregated response.

methods.name: createConnectionWithClients
methods.description: Creates a mock connection with a specified number of clients for testing.
